fullExplanation.text: Understanding Nahum: Literary Map and Major Movements

Literary Structure

A literary map of Nahum follows the book as received before isolating verses. Trace changes of speaker, setting, genre, repeated vocabulary, conflict, and resolution; then test whether the proposed divisions illuminate Nineveh, oppression, divine justice, violence, and consolation. A map is an interpretive aid rather than inspired chapter headings. Competing structures can both be useful when they account for the actual sequence, and no structure should be used to erase passages that complicate a preferred thesis.
